question: Su'aal
defaultDirections: Dooro jawaabta aad u malaynayso inay ka jawaabayso su'aasha. Markaad dhammayso, riix {checkAnswer}. Waxaad heli doontaa jawaab-celin muujinaysa saxnaanta jawaabtaada iyo sida loo sii socdo.
answerRequiresCorrection: Jawaabtu waxay u baahan tahay sixid

hintDescription: Tan waxaa la soo bandhigaa haddii isticmaaluhu jawaabta khaldo

dropzoneDirections: Dooro calaamad si aad u qaadato, kadibna dooro qaybta sawirka ay ka tirsan tahay. Dooro calaamad la dhigay si aad dib ugu qaadato. Calaamadaha qaar waxay noqon karaan dheeraad. Marka qayb kastaa calaamad leedahay, riix {checkAnswer}.
